mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_file_object (biz_type, biz_id, cos_key, content_type, size_bytes, created_by) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{cosKey}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, cos_key, content_type, size_bytes, created_by, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_file_object WHERE id = #{id}
